manifest.name: You Are Wild: Simple Narrator
manifest.description: Adds concise provider-generated narration after deterministic scene exchanges.

settings.label: Provider connection
settings.description: Choose a text-generation profile managed in AI Providers. Credentials remain session-only.

settings.label: Narration profile
settings.description: Storyteller emphasizes scene and consequence. Character reactions emphasizes observable behavior and supplied dialogue. Hybrid balances both.

settings.label: Narration instructions
settings.description: Optional style guidance applied after the selected profile. It cannot override viewpoint, profile, fact, policy, plain-text, or length constraints.
settings.default: Write concise, vivid narration focused on what the player perceives. Use second person for the player and third person for other characters. Give dialogue room when characters speak. Avoid repeating interface labels.
